description: A gray T‑shirt lies on a red bedspread in front of you, with a white pillow at the top of the bed. The left hand and right hand open and smooth the shirt flat, then the right hand pulls the right side inward toward the center and the left hand brings the left side over it, creating a long narrow fold; both hands then lift and fold the bottom end upward into a compact rectangle and adjust the edges before letting go.
